title: Present tense of regular verbs
text: The present tense of regular verbs: hablo, comes, vive. A2 Spanish grammar.

concept.name: Present tense of regular verbs
concept.description: Conjugating regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs in the present tense (hablo, comes, vive).

title: Preterite for completed events
text: The preterite narrates completed past events with a clear end: ayer hablé con Ana. B1 Spanish grammar.

concept.name: Preterite for completed events
concept.description: Narrating finished, completed actions in the past with the preterite (hablé, comí, fui).

probes.prompt: Complete: Ayer yo ___ con mi hermana. (hablar)
Complete: El sábado ella ___ al cine. (ir)

title: Preterite and imperfect contrast
text: Storytelling contrast: the imperfect sets the scene and the preterite tells what happened. B1 Spanish.

concept.name: Preterite and imperfect contrast
concept.description: Contrasting the imperfect (background, habits) with the preterite (completed events) in a story.

probes.prompt: Complete: Llovía cuando yo ___ a casa. (llegar)

title: Present subjunctive after doubt
text: After no creo que and dudo que the verb takes the present subjunctive: no creo que sea verdad. B1.

concept.name: Present subjunctive after doubt
concept.description: Using the present subjunctive after expressions of doubt and negated opinions (no creo que sea).

probes.prompt: Complete: No creo que ella ___ razón. (tener)

title: Argumentative writing
text: Argumentative writing connects a claim and reasons: por un lado, por otro lado, sin embargo. B2 Spanish.

concept.name: Argumentative writing
concept.description: Writing a short argument: a claim, reasons with connectors (por un lado, sin embargo) and a conclusion.

probes.prompt: Complete the connector: Por un lado es caro; por ___ lado es útil.
Complete: ___ embargo, no estoy de acuerdo. (contrast)

title: Linear equations
text: A linear equation is solved by undoing operations on both sides: 2x + 3 = 11 gives x = 4.

concept.name: Linear equations
concept.description: Solving one-variable linear equations by inverse operations (2x + 3 = 11).

title: Systems of linear equations
text: A system of two linear equations is solved by substitution or elimination: x + y = 5, x - y = 1.

concept.name: Systems of linear equations
concept.description: Solving two linear equations together by substitution or elimination.

probes.prompt: Solve: x + y = 5 and x - y = 1. What is x?
Solve: x + y = 7 and x - y = 3. What is y?

title: Quadratic equations
text: A quadratic equation can be solved by factoring: x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0.

probes.prompt: Solve by factoring: x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0. Give the larger root.
Solve: x^2 = 49. Give the positive root.
